title: A recursive lower bound for Schur numbers
statement:
For each integer $n \ge 1$, the Schur numbers satisfy
\[
3\,s_{n-1} \le s_n + 1,
\]
where $s_m$ denotes the least $N$ such that every partition of $\{1, 2, \ldots, N\}$ into $m$ subsets has some part containing elements $x, y, z$ with $x + y = z$. Equivalently, $s_n \ge 3 s_{n-1} - 1$.
